policies.augmentation: Apply only after splitting and only to train; never augment val or test
policies.class_imbalance: Preserved in D5; no under-sampling over-sampling class weighting or augmentation applied
policies.near_duplicate_limitation: Exact duplicate leakage is prevented; near-duplicate or same-leaf sequence leakage was not deeply assessed because no reliable grouping metadata is available
policies.test_set: FROZEN after D5; use only for final evaluation and never for tuning or selection
policies.validation_set: Use for model selection hyperparameter tuning preprocessing comparison and early stopping
